questions.prompt: Week 13 · Progressive Reform and the Modern State: What is the strongest method for evaluating “Reformers and the Regulated Society”?

Reject the source if it has a perspective or purpose.
Compare it with independent evidence and evaluate origin, purpose, context, value, and limits.
Use only the most memorable statement.
questions.explanation: Historical evidence is evaluated through sourcing, contextualization, corroboration, and attention to limitations.

questions.prompt: A city compares inspection violations before and after a new housing code. Which additional evidence would most strengthen a claim that the reform changed conditions?
choices: Enforcement records, comparable neighborhoods, inspection definitions, and evidence showing whether violations actually declined rather than merely being reported differently.
A speech praising the reform with no implementation evidence.
The number of pages in the ordinance.
A later photograph from an unrelated city.
questions.explanation: Before-and-after comparisons are stronger when measurement, enforcement, and comparison conditions are documented.
